metadata.title: EPUB 3.3 Error Fix Precision Guide (Final Commercial Fix)
metadata.description: The ultimate logic for 251 error codes. Combines searchable text markers with precise fixes for persistent errors like RSC-005. Designed for 100% pass rate.

global_rules.philosophy: Practicality & Traceability. No image generation. Replace errors with visible text markers containing '[AUTO-FIX]' so creators can find them easily.
global_rules.action_priority: 1. Format Repair. 2. Content Preservation (Unwrap). 3. Text Substitution (Marker). 4. Comment Injection.
global_rules.cascade_logic: Deep Clean: When a resource is removed, replace references with a text span: [AUTO-FIX] Resource Removed.
global_rules.search_tag: All injected text or comments MUST include '[AUTO-FIX]'.

HTM-004.hint:
CRITICAL: Line number may be -1 (unknown location)
SEARCH the ENTIRE file for DOCTYPE:
1. Use text search or regex to find ALL lines starting with "<!DOCTYPE"
2. DOCTYPE is usually near the top (lines 1-5) right after <?xml> declaration
3. DELETE the entire DOCTYPE line completely
4. ADD exactly this line: <!DOCTYPE html>
5. Example BEFORE: <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.1//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml11/DTD/xhtml11.dtd">
6. Example AFTER: <!DOCTYPE html>
7. Make sure NO extra spaces or attributes
8. Add comment after: <!--[AUTO-FIX] DOCTYPE Fixed-->
9. IMPORTANT: Replace ALL DOCTYPE declarations found, not just first one

2. When fixing OPF errors:
   - PRESERVE all <metadata> elements (dc:title, dc:identifier, dc:language, etc.)
   - PRESERVE unique-identifier="BookId" and matching <dc:identifier id="BookId">
   - PRESERVE all <manifest> and <spine> sections completely
   - ONLY modify the specific problematic attribute mentioned in error
3. VERIFY after changes:
   - unique-identifier still points to valid dc:identifier
   - All three sections (metadata, manifest, spine) still exist
   - XML structure is well-formed

For XHTML files:
1. If "empty properties" or properties="": DELETE the empty properties attribute
2. If "required attribute missing" (e.g., src on img):
   - For img tag: REMOVE entire img tag OR add src="placeholder.jpg"
   - For a tag: REMOVE href attribute or unwrap link
3. If "lang and xml:lang must have same value": Make both identical
4. If "elements from namespace not allowed": Remove invalid element
5. If other XML error: Fix tags, close unclosed tags
